messages.content:
First of all, I'm very new to online tech competitions, and have vibe coded almost everything i've done so far.

first kaggle competition here, im having a hard time navigating through iterating newer agents from modifying old agents. Continuing this loop for a while and my directory is filled with very old strategies and old agent submissions that the harness still refers to and indirectly applying strategies of the old data.

I know its almost ended but I'd like to know how others take their approach to working though such competitions and how they know what to keep and what to completely stop working on (like agents and strategies here)

Any advice would be helpful I just wanna learn more.
